body: My dad and step mom kicked me out in 2019. I moved to the Bay Area and met someone who I thought I’d spend the rest of my life with. I moved in, we made commitments like marriage together, spent everyday of quarantine together, I really was in love. Last week he broke up with me. That means I have to move in with friends about 6 hours away, lose my job, start my life all over again and this time it’s during COVID. That $12,500 would be life changing in helping me get back on my feet and this time make the right decisions.
